device.soc: ALi M3602 / M3601E (the bootloader chunk's version "SMT---1.0.0"; the main code is "Application version 1.0.0@M3606_DVBS2_SABBAT_20110323" built on Libcore 5.2.0@SDK4.0aa.5.2_20110615)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py: single-CPU M36xx with chip ID 0x3602, GeM3602 2D graphics engine at 0xB800A000, and S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator on SCB0 at 0x33)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (SMT---1.0.0, 2009-08-27), maincode 0x010000 (SMT 1.0.0, LZMA 0x1877D3 bytes -> 5.91 MB), Radioback 0x1E0000 (1.0.0), Bootback 0x1F0000 (1.0.0), upgcode 0x200000 (upg 1.0.0), defaultdb 0x210000 (1.1.0, 2011-2-8), userdb 0x22FF80 (1.0.0, 2010-10-1, 0x0E0070 bytes) -- the whole 4 MB flash

source.note: Unpacked from skybox s12.rar in the mirror's Openbox/Openbox S9-S10-S11-S12 folder.

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3602 (run_dump_skybox_s12_app_starts.py): the "SMT---1.0.0" bootloader prints "APP  init ok", unpacks the 5.91 MB maincode to 0x80000200 and starts the single-CPU application.  The application drives the 3-wire PT6964 / TM1628 front panel (PAN_PT_0) on CLK = GPIO 171, DIO = GPIO 62, STB = GPIO 170 ("boot" -> "Strt" -> "OOO7"), configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB0, and renders its 1280x720 OSD through GeM3602 (123 GE commands, 80 colours).

desc: Firmware update for the Skybox S12 HD PVR compact DVB-S2 satellite receiver (bootloader "SMT---1.0.0", Application 1.0.0@M3606_DVBS2_SABBAT_20110323, Libcore 5.2.0@SDK4.0aa.5.2_20110615), built on the single-CPU ALi M3602 platform.

Drives its 4-digit 7-segment LED display through a 3-wire PT6964 / TM1628 controller (PAN_PT_0) split across GPIO bank 1 (DIO = GPIO 62) and the legacy third GPIO bank at 0xB80000E8 (STB = GPIO 170, CLK = GPIO 171), displaying "boot", "Strt", and the active channel "OOO7".
